visualCharacteristics.purpose: In-section navigation: a list of links to sibling pages, shown as a toggle menu, a sidebar menu or a row of tab-style links, with the current page marked

contentPattern.structure: optional first row with the section title (heading or text, used as the menu toggle label); then one row per link (optional icon/image cell plus a link cell), or a single cell holding a bulleted list of links

reuseGuidance: Use for page-to-page navigation within a section. Default: collapsible toggle menu. Options: sidebar (vertical icon menu, always open on desktop), horizontal-tabs (tab-style link row). For in-page anchors use anchor-nav; for content panels that switch on the same page use tabs-panel.
